items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: that was the reason I asked for a clarinet, because of his inspiration.

ctx.x: Oh, lord . . . [The interview pauses for 27 seconds to let the telephone ring]
I recall you saying somewhere that Benny Goodman was your first idol.
Well, I was very moved by his band and his clarinet playing, more so than Artie Shaw . . . that was the reason I asked for a clarinet, because of his inspiration.
